summary: The Temporal Echo Badlands are the most unstable time‑fracture zone of the Riftlands. Events repeat, skip, or collapse; terrain shifts between past and future states; and temporal echoes manifest as hostile entities.
history: Temporal fractures spread from Discord-Core into the Riftlands after the Rift-Heart collapse.
Entire regions began looping, replaying ancient battles or future catastrophes.
Echo-Surge Steppe formed where time surged forward and backward unpredictably.
Chronoscatter Fields emerged as fragmented timelines scattered across the landscape.
The Paradox Throne appeared as a temporal nexus where multiple timelines converge.
